## buildSchemaRegistry() function

Build a registry of permissive request schemas ([buildCommandSchema()](./runtime.buildcommandschema.md)<!-- -->) for all commands.

Call this once at server startup. The returned map associates each command name with its pre-built Zod schema.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function buildSchemaRegistry(commands: Record<string, Command>): Map<string, z.ZodType>
```
